title: Fraglide-1 from traditional Chinese aromatic vinegar: A natural AhR antagonist for atopic dermatitis.
authors: Kato, Kosuke; Akamatsu, Miki; Kakimaru, Saya; Koreishi, Mayuko; Takagi, Masahiro; Miyashita, Masahiro; Murata, Yoshiyuki; Nakamura, Yoshimasa; Satoh, Ayano; Tsujino, Yoshio
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物FG1拮抗AhR信号通路治疗特应性皮炎，虽涉及分子对接但核心是细胞实验与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Traditional Chinese Zhenjiang aromatic vinegar (Kozu) contains Fraglide-1 (FG1), a bioactive lactone with demonstrated peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) agonist and antioxidant activities. This study explored FG1's novel ability to antagonize the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) signaling pathway, which regulates artemin expression and contributes to itching and inflammation in atopic dermatitis. Through molecular docking simulations and cell-based assays in human keratinocytes, we demonstrated FG1's potent antagonistic activity against AhR signaling. FG1 effectively suppressed FICZ-induced inflammatory responses, including artemin expression, with potency (half maximal inhibitory concentration, IC(50) = 5.1 muM) comparable to the synthetic antagonist StemRegenin 1 (SR1) while demonstrating a superior safety profile (median lethal concentration, LC(50) > 100 muM vs. 27.5 muM for SR1). These findings expand our understanding of bioactive compounds from traditional fermented foods and their regulatory effects on AhR signaling, providing a foundation for future studies on FG1's role in modulating skin inflammation.
abstract_zh: 传统镇江香醋（Kozu）含有Fraglide-1（FG1），这是一种具有生物活性的内酯，已证实具有过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma）激动剂和抗氧化活性。本研究探讨了FG1拮抗芳烃受体（AhR）信号通路的新能力，该通路调节artemin表达，并参与特应性皮炎的瘙痒和炎症。通过分子对接模拟和人角质形成细胞中的细胞实验，我们证明了FG1对AhR信号具有强效拮抗活性。FG1有效抑制FICZ诱导的炎症反应，包括artemin表达，其效力（半数抑制浓度，IC(50) = 5.1 μM）与合成拮抗剂StemRegenin 1（SR1）相当，同时表现出更优的安全性（半数致死浓度，LC(50) > 100 μM，而SR1为27.5 μM）。这些发现拓展了我们对传统发酵食品中生物活性化合物及其对AhR信号调节作用的理解，为未来研究FG1在调节皮肤炎症中的作用奠定了基础。
